title: Correct F1 value
description: Essential: Student must compute F₁ = 10√3/3 N (or equivalent ≈5.77 N) for part (1).

title: Correct β for minimum
description: Essential: Student must state β = 60° for the minimized tension configuration in part (2).

title: Correct minimum tension
description: Essential: Student must compute F₂ = 5 N for the minimized tension in part (2).

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: Student must apply static equilibrium conditions (ΣF_x=0, ΣF_y=0) to relate tensions and weight.

title: Force resolution geometry
description: Important: Student must correctly resolve tensions into vertical/horizontal components using angles α=30° and β.

title: Minimization reasoning
description: Important: Student must recognize that minimum tension occurs when BO is perpendicular to AO's tension direction.

title: Trigonometric calculation
description: Optional: Student correctly simplifies trigonometric expressions (cos30°, sin30°, etc.) without errors.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns component directions or uses wrong trigonometric functions (e.g., sin instead of cos).

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Student fails to include units (N, °) or uses inconsistent units in final answers.
